label: Record Access Delay
publicDescription: A formal record becomes slower to inspect as pressure rises.

support.label: Open a formal record review
support.benefitLabel: The record trail receives a stronger institutional review.
support.costLabel: Court capacity is committed while the review runs.

contain.label: Secure the custody trail
contain.costLabel: Police time is reserved for custody work.

contain.label: Build a protected source channel
contain.benefitLabel: A safer information channel can outlast the deadline.
contain.costLabel: Informant trust is committed to the operation.

label: Proof Sheet Leak
publicDescription: A public proof changes witness incentives before the case closes.

contain.label: Contain the proof sheet
contain.benefitLabel: Witness exposure is reduced while facts are checked.
